concepts.gloss_en: Psalms (the biblical book of Tehillim / reciting Psalms)

reason_for_human: Both proposed members are literally the same single occurrence (occ:legacy:noid_3923), and the vocalized form תְּהִלִּים clearly means 'reciting Psalms' as a segula for teshuvah. There is no homograph issue or ambiguity — it's one concept.
